properties.name: Every edge type declares what it means, and describe_schema serves the reading
properties.rationale: req:every-edge-type-declares-what-it-means, promoted by Anthony 2026-09-28. The meaning of an edge is encoded today in at least six private lists with nothing keeping them in agreement (structural_rule, is_traceability_edge, RISK_EDGES, COMMITMENT_EDGES, ARTIFACT_BOOKKEEPING, and the five projection lists of 2026-08-14), and one edge is already used against its meaning (DriftEvent → Anchor drawn as DEPENDS_ON). A declared reading is the one source those can move onto.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: BUILT: EdgeTypeDef gains an optional `reading` (a Reading core, modifiers, per-value `splits`, basis). Every edge type in schema/*.yaml declares one, fifteen of them with splits, all basis classified. describe_schema serves a one-line `reads_as` on every read and the whole reading on a from/to query, and counts readings by basis. DesignGraph::edge_types_read_as returns the types that always mean a primitive apart from those decided per edge, and edge_reads_as / edge_is_read_as read one edge from its own values. tests/every_edge_type_declares_what_it_means.rs: five tests, observed failing first. Additive: no endpoint, property or validation rule changes.
